note_content: 51-year-old male with hypertension and chronic kidney disease stage 3b. eGFR 38 mL/min/1.73m2, serum creatinine 2.1 mg/dL. Potassium stable at 4.6 mEq/L. Blood pressure 142/88. Renal ultrasound shows bilateral cortical thinning without hydronephrosis.

43-year-old female presents with recurrent right upper quadrant colicky pain postprandially. Abdominal ultrasound confirms cholelithiasis with multiple gallstones and mild gallbladder wall thickening (3.5 mm). Referred for elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy.

63-year-old male status-post left hemicolectomy for Stage IIA colon adenocarcinoma. Surveillance CT scan of chest/abdomen/pelvis reveals no evidence of local recurrence or distant metastatic disease. CEA level remains within normal limits at 1.8 ng/mL.

28-year-old female with severe refractory atopic dermatitis and allergic rhinitis. Total serum IgE markedly elevated at 1,450 IU/mL. Initiated on Dupilumab 600mg loading dose followed by 300mg biweekly. Tolerating medication well with partial symptom relief.

72-year-old male with severe tricompartmental osteoarthritis of right knee. Radiographs reveal bone-on-bone medial compartment joint space narrowing with subchondral sclerosis and osteophyte formation. Scheduled for right total knee arthroplasty.
